name: scrape-reliability
title: Scrape reliability
description: Success-rate card, a request log in a dot window, and three cards on what runs on every request.
usage: The home page's reliability section ("Every page, fully loaded."), between the product grid and the use cases. The rate, the request log (steps with a time, a mark and a detail, a blocked step drawn as a ring) and the three pillars take the site's copy by default; pass your own through props.
avoid: A green check or red cross in the log (a solid dot for a step that went through
a ring for one that was blocked)
A chart in place of the single figure
notes:
The rate card and the log sit side by side from lg (0.8 to 1.4), stacked below; the pillars go three across from md.
The log's times and details hide on phones, leaving the mark and the step.

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
